verses.saheeh: When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness]
verses.khattab: When the sun is put out
verses.jalalayn: ﻿When the sun is folded away, enfolded and stripped of its light,

verses.saheeh: And when the stars fall, dispersing,
verses.khattab: and when the stars fall down
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and when the stars scatter, [when] they are extinguished and hurtle down towards the earth,

verses.saheeh: And when the mountains are removed
verses.khattab: and when the mountains are blown away
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and when the mountains are set in motion, [when] they are blown away from the face of the earth, becoming as scattered dust,

verses.saheeh: And when full-term she-camels are neglected
verses.khattab: and when pregnant camels are left untended
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and when the pregnant camels are neglected, abandoned without a herdsman or anyone to milk them, on account of the matter that has come over them — even though [previously] no wealth was dearer to them than these [pregnant camels];

verses.saheeh: And when the wild beasts are gathered
verses.khattab: and when wild beasts are gathered together
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and when the wild beasts are mustered, [when they are] brought together after being resurrected so that each of them may retaliate against the other, before becoming dust;

verses.saheeh: And when the seas are filled with flame
verses.khattab: and when the seas are set on fire
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and when the seas are set afire (read sujirat or sujjirat), [when] they are set alight and become [a mass of] fire;

verses.saheeh: And when the souls are paired
verses.khattab: and when the souls ˹and their bodies˺ are paired ˹once more˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and when the souls are coupled, [when they are] paired up with their bodies;

verses.saheeh: And when the girl [who was] buried alive is asked
verses.khattab: and when baby girls, buried alive, are asked
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and when the girl buried-alive, the young girl buried alive for fear of shame and impoverishment, asks — in rebuke of its slayer —

verses.saheeh: For what sin she was killed
verses.khattab: for what crime they were put to death
verses.jalalayn: ﻿for what sin she was slain (sa’alat, ‘asks’: a variant reading has su’ilat, ‘[she] is asked’, narrating the address directed to her, to which she then responds by saying, ‘I was slain without [having committed] any sin’);

verses.saheeh: And when the pages are made public
verses.khattab: and when the records ˹of deeds˺ are laid open
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and when the scrolls, the scrolls containing the deeds, are unrolled (read nushirat or nushshirat), [when they are] unfolded and spread out;

verses.saheeh: And when the sky is stripped away
verses.khattab: and when the sky is stripped away
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and when the heaven is stripped off, torn away from its place, just as the skin of a sheep is stripped off;

verses.saheeh: And when Hellfire is set ablaze
verses.khattab: and when the Hellfire is fiercely flared up
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and when the Hell-fire is set ablaze (read su‘irat or su‘‘irat), [when it is] set alight;

verses.saheeh: And when Paradise is brought near,
verses.khattab: and when Paradise is brought near—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and when Paradise is brought near, [when it is] brought close to those who have merited it, that they may enter it (the response to idhā, ‘when’, at the beginning of the sūra and all that has been supplemented thereto is [the following]):

verses.saheeh: A soul will [then] know what it has brought [with it].
verses.khattab: ˹on that Day˺ each soul will know what ˹deeds˺ it has brought along
verses.jalalayn: ﻿[then] a soul, every soul, at the time of the [occurrence of the] things mentioned, which is the Day of Resurrection, will know what it has presented, of good or evil.

verses.saheeh: So I swear by the retreating stars -
verses.khattab: I do swear by the receding stars
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So I swear (fa-lā: lā is extra) by the receding [planets],

verses.saheeh: Those that run [their courses] and disappear -
verses.khattab: which travel and hide
verses.jalalayn: ﻿the movers, the setters, that is, the five planets: Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Venus and Mercury (takhnusu means ‘they sink away’ during their orbit, whereas we see stars at the end of their zodiacal course return to the start; taknisu means that they enter their kinās, ‘hideaway’, in other words, they retreat into their setting-places);

verses.saheeh: And by the night as it closes in
verses.khattab: and the night as it falls
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and [by] the night as it approaches, as it falls with its darkness, or [it means] as it recedes;

verses.saheeh: And by the dawn when it breathes
verses.khattab: and the day as it breaks
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and [by] the dawn as it breathes, [as] it extends until it becomes broad daylight,

verses.saheeh: [That] indeed, the Qur'an is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger
verses.khattab: Indeed, this ˹Quran˺ is the Word of ˹Allah delivered by Gabriel,˺ a noble messenger-angel
verses.jalalayn: ﻿truly this, Qur'an, is the word of a messenger [who is] noble, in the sight of God, exalted be He — this being [the messenger] Gabriel (it [qawl, ‘word’] has been annexed to him, because he descends with it),

verses.uthmani: ذِي قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِي ٱلۡعَرۡشِ مَكِينٖ
verses.indopak: ذِىْ قُوَّةٍ عِنْدَ ذِى الْعَرْشِ مَكِيْنٍۙ
verses.saheeh: [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position],
verses.khattab: full of power, held in honour by the Lord of the Throne
verses.jalalayn: ﻿powerful, one of mighty powers, eminent, one of eminent status (makīnin is semantically connected ‘inda, ‘in the presence of’) in the presence of the Lord of the Throne, that is, God, exalted be He;

verses.saheeh: Obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy.
verses.khattab: obeyed there ˹in heaven˺, and trustworthy
verses.jalalayn: ﻿obeyed there, the angels obey him in the heavens, trustworthy, with the Revelation.

verses.saheeh: And your companion is not [at all] mad.
verses.khattab: And your fellow man is not insane
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And your companion, Muhammad (s) (wa-mā sāhibukum: a supplement to [the clause from] innahu, ‘truly this is’, up to the last of the oath clauses) is not a madman, as you claim.

verses.saheeh: And he has already seen Gabriel in the clear horizon.
verses.khattab: And he did see that ˹angel˺ on the clear horizon
verses.jalalayn: ﻿For verily he, Muhammad (s), saw him, Gabriel, in the form in which he was created, on the clear horizon, the highest one, towards the east;

verses.saheeh: And Muhammad is not a withholder of [knowledge of] the unseen.
verses.khattab: and he does not withhold ˹what is revealed to him of˺ the unseen
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and he, Muhammad (s), is not to be accused of [knowing] the Unseen, what is hidden of the revelation and the tidings of the heaven (a variant reading [for bi-zanīnin] has bi-danīnin, meaning that he is not ‘niggardly’ [with the Unseen] so as to reduce something of it [and not disclose it]).

verses.saheeh: And the Qur'an is not the word of a devil, expelled [from the heavens].
verses.khattab: And this ˹Quran˺ is not the word of an outcast devil
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And it, that is, the Qur'an, is not the word of an accursed satan, eavesdropping stealthily.

verses.saheeh: So where are you going?
verses.khattab: So what ˹other˺ path would you take
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So where are you going? So what path are you going to follow in repudiating the Qur'an and turning away from it?

verses.saheeh: It is not except a reminder to the worlds
verses.khattab: Surely this ˹Quran˺ is only a reminder to the whole world—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿It is only a reminder, an admonition, for all worlds, [those of] mankind and jinn,

verses.saheeh: For whoever wills among you to take a right course.
verses.khattab: to whoever of you wills to take the Straight Way
verses.jalalayn: ﻿for those of you who (li-man shā’a minkum is a substitution for li’l-‘ālamīna, ‘for all worlds’, using the same preposition) wish to go straight, by following the truth;

verses.uthmani: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.indopak: وَمَا تَشَاۤءُوْنَ اِلَّاۤ اَنْ يَّشَاۤءَ اللّٰهُ رَبُّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ٪
verses.transliteration: wama tashaoona illa an yashaa allahu rabbu al'alameena
verses.saheeh: And you do not will except that Allah wills - Lord of the worlds.
verses.khattab: But you cannot will ˹to do so˺, except by the Will of Allah, the Lord of all worlds
verses.jalalayn: ﻿but you will not [wish], to go straight along the [path of] truth, unless God, the Lord of the Worlds, [of all] creatures, wills, that you should go straight along it.
